analytics.name: Analytic 1730
analytics.guidance: The defender correlates anomalous application package replacement, update, or executable-content drift with subsequent execution under the trusted application's identity, especially when package metadata, signing lineage, install source, file integrity, or native/DEX component characteristics change without a corresponding trusted distribution path. The analytic prioritizes Android-observable control-plane effects: package install/update events, package hash or code-section drift, signer mismatch or lineage break, unexpected app process behavior after replacement, and optional near-term network or sensor activity inconsistent with the legitimate application's baseline.

tuning.description: Correlation window between package replacement, code drift, first launch, and follow-on behavior
Applications legitimately expected to update frequently or use staged package delivery
Expected install or update sources such as managed store, Google Play, or enterprise MDM
Approved signing certificates, rotation chains, and version lineage for managed apps
Expected package cache, installer, and app storage locations involved in legitimate updates
Degree of executable-content or metadata change tolerated before alerting
Whether package replacement and first launch should occur only during active user-driven workflows
Minimum outbound volume after first execution of replaced app to treat post-compromise communication as meaningful
